groups.rationale: Reviewed upstream admission selection, refusal replay and fixed unexercised diagnostics plus labelled satellite administrative-enable stub against merged Chapter17. Native boot-log and OmniOS assembly evidence is preserved. Stub logic establishes no native capacity, readiness, KVM or isolation; Ash ownership and deployment stay unchanged.

Reviewed merged Chapter17 additions for the Antithesis harness and preserved Chapters08/19/20 host diagnostic authority. Upstream changes no Marshall production source, Cedar mapping, native admission, boot-log request fencing or browser evidence; harness administrative enablement is explicitly labelled a stub.

Reviewed pinned dev/test-only Hegel dependency and two bounded seeded terminal frame properties. Production codecs, schemas, native capability rows and wire identities are unchanged. Existing handbook distinguishes BEAM properties from native machine evidence; adding these properties does not record their execution.

Reviewed merged shared Chapter17 stub limitations against unchanged Lilly production source and retained independent host-log custody evidence. The upstream harness cannot fabricate Lilly readiness, capacity or VM authority; no execution fencing, storage ownership or native admission behavior changed.

Reviewed labelled satellite administrative-enable fixture and preserved typed OmniOS growth operand evidence. Upstream changes no Lyra, Audi, Ziggy or Galileo production source or credentials boundary; the controlled host remains execution-unready and no native service acceptance is added.

Reviewed machine wrappers supplying evaluated Lilly service UID and typed optional process and JSON object narrowing in conversion/backup drivers. They preserve existing custody and assertions and add no recorded machine execution, host, service placement or topology. Native assembly and pending runtime scope remain explicit.

Reviewed structural completion of upstream ADR0191 metadata, required sections, concrete protocol source links and index row. This preserves its accepted test-only Hegel policy and explicitly partial migration and unexecuted evidence scope. Existing merged Chapter17 and scenario/native boundaries remain accurate; no handbook behavior, authority, domain or deployment changes.
